candidate.answerReason: There are 3^7 unrestricted assignments. Removing the assignments with either required bag empty and correcting their single overlap gives 3^7−2·2^7+1=1932, agreeing with choice C.

methods.label: Remove assignments with a required bag empty
methods.explanation:
An arrangement is determined by choosing a bag for each distinct candy. With no restrictions, each of the seven candies has three choices, giving \(3^7\) arrangements. Every arrangement is counted once because its seven bag choices determine exactly which candies each bag contains.

If the red bag is empty, every candy goes into the blue or white bag, giving \(2^7\) arrangements. Similarly, \(2^7\) arrangements have the blue bag empty.

Subtracting both counts removes the all-white arrangement twice, because it has both required bags empty. That is their only overlap, so add it back once. The resulting count removes every forbidden arrangement exactly once:
\[
3^7-2^7-2^7+1
=2187-128-128+1
=\boxed{1932}.
\]
The white bag may be empty, so no further arrangements are excluded. The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
